{{Quote|Good heroes they. Drive hard bargain|King Ebereebaveebeedee, after declaring the pact|<ref name="Scavenger Hunt">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>}}
[[King/Legends|King]] [[Ebareebaveebeedee]] of the [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Species/Legends|species]] declared a '''pact''' of mutual support with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after a group of Rebel [[operative]]s helped the Squibs recover a [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projector]] from the [[Paradise system/Legends|Paradise system]], home to the Squibs' main rivals, the [[Ugor/Legends|Ugors]]. He communicated the pact via a sealed [[Datacard/Legends|datapack]], which the Rebels were instructed not to unlock until returned to their superior [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in the Alliance. Upon completion of their mission, the Rebels did so, and a huge [[holograph]]ic image of Ebareebaveebeedee appeared above them to swear the pact. The Squib [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] [[Spilferithimus-narlamos]] attested to the deal, and the Squibs awaited the signature of Rebel leader [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to finish the alliance. The king requested that the Rebel operatives who had aided the Squibs be named ambassadors to his species, a position that afforded them special rights and discount privileges from the Squibs.
